description: This PHP class 'BuzzLikeOnCommentDecorator' acts as a decorator for the 'BuzzLikeOnComment' entity, providing helper methods to associate employees and comments by their IDs, and to format the date/time when a like was registered on a comment within the OrangeHRM social feature.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for handling 'BuzzLikeOnComment' entity with methods to set employee and comment references and retrieve formatted liked date/time.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a 'BuzzLikeOnComment' entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an employee with the like based on employee number.

methods.name: setCommentByCommentId
methods.description: Associates a comment with the like based on comment ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the like was made, formatted as a date string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the like was made, formatted as a time string.
